title: Finnish Satellite Company Offers €2 Billion to Buy Italian Rocket Maker! 🇫🇮🇮🇹
body: Finnish Satellite Company Offers €2 Billion to Buy Italian Rocket Maker! 🇫🇮🇮🇹
Finnish company ICEYE, which specialises in satellites, has made a cash offer worth €2 billion to buy Italian company Avio, the maker of the Vega rockets.
The goal is to build an integrated European space and defence group and reduce dependence on outside providers such as Starshield, the military satellite service run by SpaceX.

The deal needs the Italian government's approval through a special right called the "golden power", which lets the state block deals involving strategic companies, and Italy's defence minister has asked Leonardo — which owns 18% of Avio — to "think carefully" before selling.
The offer was made on Tuesday 17 November at €41 per share, while Avio's shares are at €39.75 — below the offer price.
